# Universal Scheduling Protocol (USP)

> USP is an open standard that enables platforms and AI agents to discover, check availability of, and book time-based services from businesses.

USP defines the complete scheduling domain — service catalog, availability, holds, and bookings — with support for appointments, group sessions, reservations, and rentals. It offers two deployment modes: UCP-Native Mode (for platforms using the Universal Commerce Protocol) and Standalone Mode (for self-contained deployments). USP supports REST, MCP, A2A, and ESP transport bindings.

Version: 2026-08-20
Status: Draft
License: Apache 2.0

## Documentation

- [Specification Overview](https://usp-protocol.dev/specification/): Protocol overview, conventions, terminology, and reading guide
- [Service Catalog](https://usp-protocol.dev/specification/service-catalog/): Service discovery — types, pricing, policies, resources, duration, and catalog feed
- [Availability](https://usp-protocol.dev/specification/availability/): Time slot queries (slot and day granularity), holds, and caching strategy
- [Booking Lifecycle](https://usp-protocol.dev/specification/booking/): Create, confirm, cancel, reschedule bookings with webhook notifications
- [Discovery Registry](https://usp-protocol.dev/specification/discovery-registry/): Optional centralized business and service discovery
- [Core Concepts](https://usp-protocol.dev/core-concepts/): Roles (Platform, Business, CP, PSP), architecture, constructs, namespaces
- [Getting Started](https://usp-protocol.dev/getting-started/): Implementation guide with deployment mode selection and step-by-step stages

## Deployment Modes

- [UCP-Native Mode](https://usp-protocol.dev/deployment-modes/ucp-native/): For platforms supporting UCP — atomic checkout, inherited infrastructure
- [Standalone Mode](https://usp-protocol.dev/deployment-modes/standalone/): Self-contained — /.well-known/usp, generic payment_context, ACP extension

## Transport Bindings

- [REST](https://usp-protocol.dev/transport/rest/): HTTP/OpenAPI 3.x with idempotency — primary transport
- [MCP](https://usp-protocol.dev/transport/mcp/): JSON-RPC for AI agent tool use via Model Context Protocol
- [A2A](https://usp-protocol.dev/transport/a2a/): Agent-to-Agent protocol for autonomous multi-agent interactions
- [ESP](https://usp-protocol.dev/transport/esp/): Embedded Scheduling Protocol for in-app booking UIs via iframe

## Additional

- [Security](https://usp-protocol.dev/security/): TLS, webhook signatures (RFC 9421), OAuth 2.0, hold abuse prevention
- [Extensions](https://usp-protocol.dev/extensions/): Waitlist extension and vendor-defined capabilities
- [Roadmap](https://usp-protocol.dev/roadmap/): Current status, planned verticals, contribution guidelines

## Machine-Readable Artifacts

- OpenAPI 3.1.0: https://github.com/wix/universal-scheduling-protocol/blob/master/https://usp-protocol.dev/schemas/openapi/usp-rest.json
- OpenRPC: https://github.com/wix/universal-scheduling-protocol/blob/master/https://usp-protocol.dev/schemas/openrpc/usp-mcp.json
- JSON Schemas: https://github.com/wix/universal-scheduling-protocol/tree/master/schemas

## Service Verticals

- appointment: 1:1 sessions (salon, dental, consulting, therapy)
- group: Limited-capacity sessions (yoga, workshops, cooking classes)
- reservation: Shared resource holds (restaurant tables, conference rooms)
- rental: Temporary use of equipment or space (car rental, studio space)

## Key Operations

| Operation | REST | MCP Method |
|-----------|------|------------|
| List Services | POST /services/list | usp/services.list |
| Get Service | GET /services/{id} | usp/services.get |
| Query Availability | POST /availability/query | usp/availability.query |
| Hold Slot | POST /availability/holds | usp/availability.hold |
| Release Hold | DELETE /availability/holds/{id} | usp/availability.release |
| Create Booking | POST /bookings | usp/bookings.create |
| Get Booking | GET /bookings/{id} | usp/bookings.get |
| Cancel Booking | POST /bookings/{id}/cancel | usp/bookings.cancel |
| Reschedule Booking | POST /bookings/{id}/reschedule | usp/bookings.reschedule |
